answer_1.quote: The primary motivation of our current work lies in generating responses that are engaging, emotionally appropriate, and also integrates the personal interests of the user.

answer_2.quote: Automatic Evaluation Metrics: In order to assess the model at the emotional and grammatical level, we present the results using the traditional automatic metrics. Perplexity is stated to test our proposed framework at the content level. We also report the results using the standard metrics like BLEU-4 and Rouge-L to measure the ability of the generated response for capturing the correct information... We report Distinct-1 and Distinct-2 metrics... To measure the emotional content in the generated responses, we calculate the emotion accuracy using the pre-trained BERT classifier...

answer_3.quote: To measure the emotional content in the generated responses, we calculate the emotion accuracy using the pre-trained BERT classifier on the responses generated by the baseline and proposed models.

answer_4.quote: Human Evaluation Metrics: We randomly sample 500 responses from the test set for human evaluation. For a given input along with persona information, six annotators with post-graduate exposure were assigned to evaluate the quality of the generated responses... First, we evaluate the quality of the response on two conventional criteria: Fluency, and Relevance. These are rated on a five-scale... Secondly, we evaluate the persona, sentiment and emotion inclusion in response in terms of Persona Consistency metric, Sentiment Coherence metric and Emotion Appropriateness...
answer_4.guideline: evaluate the quality of the response on two conventional criteria: Fluency, and Relevance; and evaluate persona, sentiment and emotion inclusion in terms of Persona Consistency, Sentiment Coherence, and Emotion Appropriateness
